Do you know any sayings in Korean?
Which saying do you like? Why?
talk. To speak; (saying) to have power or influence.
everybody. All the people in a group or in the world.
blind. Not able to see; not able to notice problems.
tell. To give information; to show or make clear.
action. Something you do to reach a goal.
bed. A piece of furniture you sleep on.
money. Coins and paper you use to buy things.
time. Minutes, hours and days as they pass.
chase. To run after someone or something to catch it.
